notes.title: Play & Chat with the Developers of Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion
notes.content:
Join us for this special [b]Steam Next Fest Event[/b] featuring the developers from [b]Stendhal Games[/b] as they dive into the captivating world of [b]Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue[/b]. Get a sneak peek at the game, witness exciting gameplay, and engage in real-time discussions with the creators.

[list]
[*] [b]Exclusive Demo:[/b] Be among the first to experience the magic of [b]Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue[/b] with an exclusive demo.
[*] [b]Live Gameplay:[/b] Watch the developers play the game, showcasing its unique features and mechanics.
[*] [b]Q&A Session:[/b] Have burning questions? Interact directly with the developers during the live Q&A segment.
[*] [b]Behind-the-Scenes Insights:[/b] Gain insights into the game’s development process, art style, and narrative.
[*] [b]Community Interaction:[/b] Connect with fellow fans and share your excitement for this epic action role-playing adventure.
[/list]
Mark your calendars and prepare to immerse your-self in the mystical world of [b]Arcanima[/b]. Don’t miss this opportunity to be part of the journey before the official release!

[previewyoutube=GPRdKBkiJQI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion[/b] combines Hack N Slash combat with JRPG elements, promising a deep and emotional story set in a world full of mysteries. Join us as we unravel the secrets of the Citadel of Indomita and explore the multicolored fog known as the ‘Mist of Oblivion’. See you there! 🌟🎮🔮
